crossRefs.note: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee, and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: When Jesus had finished all these words, he said to his disciples,
translations.bsb: When Jesus had finished saying all these things, He told His disciples,
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these words, he said unto his disciples,
